affiliate-marketing.title: Day 1 — Affiliate Marketing Kaise Kam Karta Hai? (Basics Se Shuru)
sections: Affiliate marketing ek aisa business model hai jahan tum kisi company/product ka promotion karte ho, aur har successful sale ya lead ke bad tumhe commission milti hai. Yeh ek "win-win" system hai: company ko extra sales milti hain, aur tumhe paise milte hain bina koi product banaye. Isme 4 key players hote hain: **Merchant** (product owner), **Affiliate** (tum), **Consumer** (customer), aur **Network** (Amazon Associates, ClickBank, etc.).

Imagine tum ek fitness blogger ho. Tum ek protein powder ka affiliate link apne blog par share karte ho. Koi reader us link se protein powder khareedta hai, toh tumhe har sale par 10% commission milti hai. Yeh process automatic hota hai—tumhe direct customer se deal karne ki zaroorat nahi.

Apne phone ya laptop se ek product search karo jo tum bech sakte ho (e.g., wireless earbuds, skincare product). Uske affiliate program ke liye apply karo (Amazon Associates, Daraz, etc.). Agar approval mil jaye, toh us product ka affiliate link generate karo.

Ek WhatsApp group ya Facebook post banaye jisme tum ek affiliate product promote karo. Post mein product ka naam, price, aur affiliate link share karo. (Note: Disclosure add karna mat bhulna—"Affiliate link" likh dena.)
affiliate-marketing.answer_key: affiliate link generate, commission structure, product promotion, approval process

affiliate-marketing.title: Day 2
affiliate-marketing.preamble: **Day 2 — Affiliate Links Placement: Kahan aur Kaise Lagayein?**
sections: Affiliate links ko sahi jagah par place karna zaroori hai—nahi toh traffic bhi hai aur clicks bhi nahi. Links ko natural tarike se content mein integrate karna chahiye, taake readers ko lagay na ki tum unko "bech rahe ho". Sabse effective places hain: product reviews, comparison posts, "best of" lists, aur "how-to" guides. Har platform (blog, YouTube, social media) ke liye placement strategy alag hoti hai.

Ek "Top 5 Budget Smartphones 2024" post mein har product ke naam ke neeche affiliate link lagao, lekin "Check Price" ya "Buy Now" button ke saath.
2.

Video description mein sabse pehle affiliate links dalo (Amazon Associates ke liye), phir aur details. Video ke do minute ke baad bhi link mention kar sakte ho.
3.
Caption mein "Link in bio" use karo, ya phir reel ke description mein link add karo (agar allowed ho).

Apne ek existing blog post ya social media post ko edit karo aur **2-3 natural affiliate links** add karo. Links ko aise place karo jaise tum kisi dost ko recommend kar rahe ho—na ki "hard sell" kar rahe ho.

Ek **100-150 words ka micro-blog post** likho jisme ek product recommend karna hai. Post mein:
- Product ka naam aur ek short review.
- "Check Price" button (affiliate link).
- Disclosure line add karo (e.g., "Yeh post mein affiliate links hain").
affiliate-marketing.answer_key: product review, natural placement, disclosure, cta

affiliate-marketing.title: Day 3 — Amazon Associates vs Daraz Affiliate: Kaunsa Choose Karein?
sections: Amazon Associates aur Daraz Affiliate dono hi popular affiliate programs hain, lekin inke beech key differences hain. Amazon Associates global hai aur zyada products offer karta hai, jabki Daraz local hai aur Pakistan/SAARC regions par focus karta hai. Commission rates, payment methods aur approval criteria bhi alag hain.

Agar aap electronics par content bana rahe hain, toh Amazon par har product ka unique affiliate link milta hai. Commission 1-10% tak ho sakti hai.
2.
Agar aap local fashion ya groceries par content bana rahe hain, toh Daraz par higher commission rates (10-20%) mil sakti hain, lekin approval process strict hai.
Apne niche ke hisab se decide karein ke aapko Amazon Associates ya Daraz Affiliate program join karna chahiye. 2 reasons likhein kyun aapka choice sahi hai.
Ek simple comparison table banaein (2 columns: Amazon Associates vs Daraz Affiliate) aur 3 key points (commission, approval process, best niche) fill karein.
affiliate-marketing.answer_key: amazon: global reach, low approval, 1-10%, daraz: local focus, high commission, strict approval

youtube-automation.title: Day 1 — Niche Select Karna: Apna YouTube Channel Ka Foundation
sections: Niche select karna YouTube channel ka sabse pehla aur sabse important step hai. Niche matlab aapka channel ka topic ya subject jismein aap videos banayenge. Ek achha niche aapko consistent content ideas deta hai, audience attract karta hai, aur competition bhi manage karne mein help karta hai. Apna niche choose karte waqt apne interests, skills, aur market demand ko consider karna zaroori hai.

Maana aapko fitness pasand hai. Ab aapko decide karna hai ki aap fitness ke kis specific area par focus karna chahte hain. Jaise:
- Gym beginners guide
- Home workout for women
- Weight loss diet plans
- Yoga for stress relief
Is tarah se niche select karne se aapko content ideas bhi easily mil jayenge aur audience bhi targeted rahegi.
Apne interests aur skills list karein. Fir 3-5 topics select karein jinpar aap videos bana sakte hain. Har topic ke liye 3-5 content ideas sochiye.

Ek simple Google search karein aur har topic ke liye competition check karein. Har topic ke liye YouTube search bar mein type karein aur dekhein ki kitne videos hain aur unke views kya hain. Isse aapko pata chalega ki aapka selected niche kitna competitive hai.
youtube-automation.answer_key: fitness, home workout, weight loss, yoga

youtube-automation.title: Day 2 — AI Se YouTube Script Likhne Ka Step-by-Step Guide
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke AI tools (jaise ChatGPT, Jasper, ya Copy.ai) ka istemal karke professional YouTube scripts kaise likhe. AI se script likhte waqt inhe "human touch" dena zaroori hai—aisa content jo viewers ko engage kare. Hum AI ko prompt kaise dein, uske output ko improve karein, aur final script ko apne niche ke hisaab se customize karein.

"Ek 5-minute YouTube script likho about 'How to Start a YouTube Channel in 2024' for beginners. Use simple Urdu/Hindi language, include 3 main points, and end with a call-to-action."
2.

AI ek draft dega—usko edit karke:
   - Introduction ko zyada engaging banayein (e.g., "Aaj main aapko bataunga ke YouTube channel kaise start kar sakte hain—bina kisi investment ke!")
   - Points ko real-life examples se samjhayein (e.g., "Jaise maine apne channel par 'Tech Tips' series shuru ki thi...")
   - CTA ko specific banayein (e.g., "Agar aapko yeh video pasand aaye to 'Subscribe' zaroor karen aur niche comment mein poochhein ke aapka niche kya hai.")
Apne niche ke hisaab se ek YouTube video ka script likhein. AI tool (jaise ChatGPT) ka istemal karke ek 3-5 minute ke script ka draft taiyar karen. Uske baad usko apne style mein edit karen.
Ek 1-minute ka "Hook" script likhein jo AI se generate karke usko apne voice ya style mein customize karen. Isse aapko pata chalega ke AI se content kaise modify karna hai.
youtube-automation.answer_key: script draft, human touch editing, niche-specific examples, engaging cta

youtube-automation.title: Day 3 — AI-Powered Video Editing: CapCut aur Pictory Se Professional Videos Banana
sections: AI tools jaise CapCut aur Pictory se faceless videos edit karna seekhna hai. In tools se auto-captioning, transitions, aur background music lagana asaan ho jata hai. CapCut mobile/PC par free hai, jabki Pictory cloud-based hai aur stock footage provide karta hai.

1. **CapCut mein video import karo** (mobile/PC par).
2. **AI se auto-captioning** (Text > Auto Captions) lagao.
3. **Transitions** (Effects > Basic) add karo (e.g., fade in/out).
4. **Background music** (Audio > AI Music) select karo.
5. **Export** (1080p, 30fps) karo.
Apne phone/PC par CapCut install karo, koi 30-second ka clip import karo, aur uspar auto-captioning + ek transition add karo.

Ek 1-minute ka faceless video clip banayo jisme:
- 1 stock footage clip ho (Pexels/Pixabay se download karo).
- Auto-captioning + 2 transitions hon.
- Background music ho (CapCut ke AI music se).
youtube-automation.answer_key: stock footage, auto captions, transitions, background music

social-media-marketing.title: Day 1 — Social Media Strategy: Kya hai aur Kaise Banaye?
sections: Social media strategy ek roadmap hai jo batati hai ke aap apne business ya personal brand ke liye social media par kya achieve karna chahte hain, kaise karna hai, aur kaise measure karna hai. Ismein aapke target audience, goals, content type, posting schedule, aur engagement plan shamil hote hain. Bina strategy ke, aap blindly post karte rahenge aur results bhi blind rahenge.

Maana ke aap ek fitness coach hain. Aapki strategy yeh ho sakti hai:
1.

3 months mein 10,000 followers aur 50 leads (free consultation sign-ups).
2.

20-35 saal ke gym jaane wale young professionals.
3.

Monday - Workout Tips, Wednesday - Diet Plans, Friday - Client Success Stories, Sunday - Q&A Reels.
4.

Instagram (main), YouTube Shorts (secondary), LinkedIn (for B2B clients).
5.
Har post par 10-15 comments ka reply, weekly polls, aur DMs ka 24-hour response.

Apne business ya ek fictional brand ke liye 3 main goals likhein (e.g., brand awareness, leads, sales). Phir un goals ko achieve karne ke liye 3 content ideas sujhao jo aapke target audience ko engage karein.

Ek 1-week ka rough content calendar banayein (platform, post type, aur topic ke saath). Example:
- Instagram Reel: "5 Minute Warm-up Routine" (Monday)
- LinkedIn Post: "How Fitness Boosts Productivity" (Wednesday)
- YouTube Short: "Gym Mistakes Beginners Make" (Friday)
social-media-marketing.answer_key: goals define karna, audience research, content types

social-media-marketing.title: Day 2 — **Viral Reels/Shorts Banane ke 5 Golden Rules**
sections: Viral Reels ya Shorts banane ke liye 3 cheez zaroori hain: **Attention Grab Karna** (pehle 3 seconds), **Engagement Trigger Karna** (like/comment/share ke liye reason dena), aur **Trend ka Sahi Use Karna**. Bina plan ke upload karne se chance kam hote hain. Aaj hum in 5 rules par focus karenge jo har viral content ki backbone hoti hain.

Ek **food recipe Reel** ka example lete hain:
1.

"Yeh 1 minute ka recipe aapki dinner ko banaye *chef’s kiss*!" (bold text + fast zoom on dish)
2.

"POV: Aapke fridge mein sirf *2 eggs* hain" (trending audio + text overlay)
3.

"Comment mein batao aapka favorite breakfast kya hai? ⬇️" (screen pe text + arrow)
4.

"Agar pasand aaya to share zaroor karna!" (caption mein link add karke)
5.

Apne phone se ek **15-30 sec ka Reel shoot karo** jisme:
- Pehle 3 seconds mein koi shocking/interesting shot ho (e.g., ek cheez ka explosion, fast transition, ya bold text).
- Trendy audio use karo (Instagram/Reels explore page se check karo).
- Caption mein ek question ya CTA add karo.

Ek **7-day content calendar** banaye jisme har din ke liye alag type ka Reel idea ho (e.g., Monday: "POV" trend, Tuesday: "Before & After", Wednesday: "Myth Buster"). Har idea ke saath ek trendy audio ka naam bhi likhna.
social-media-marketing.answer_key: fast transition, trendy audio, engagement prompt, cta

social-media-marketing.title: Day 3 — Instagram Growth Tactics: 30K+ Followers ka Secret
sections: Instagram par organic growth ka formula hai "Engagement + Consistency + Niche Authority". Aaj hum 3 tactics seekhenge jo 30K+ followers tak le ja sakte hain: 1) **First 60 Minutes Rule** (algorithm ko signal do ke video viral ho rahi hai), 2) **Comment Pods** (engagement boost karne ka chhupa hua tareeqa), 3) **Collab Posts** (niche ke influencers ke saath cross-promotion).

Step-by-step **First 60 Minutes Rule**:
1. Reel upload karne ke **pehle 10 minute** mein 5 close friends ko DM karke video dekhne ko kahen.
2. Upload ke **pehle 30 minute** mein 3-4 comments likhein (apne niche ke keywords ke saath).
3. Pehle **60 minute** mein 100+ views hone ke baad, algorithm "trending" maanta hai aur reach badha deta hai.

Apne niche ke **3 influencers** ko DM karke poochhein ke woh aapke Reel par comment karenge ya nahin. (Template: *"Hi [Name], main [Your Name] hun. Aapke content se inspire ho kar maine ek Reel banaya hai. Agar aapko pasand aaye to pehle 60 minute mein ek comment kar dena — isse hum sabki reach badhegi! 🙏"*)

Ek **collab Reel** plan karen:
- Niche: Fitness
- Collab partner: @GymMotivationIndia (100K+ followers)
- Idea: "5 Minute Warm-up Routine" (aap 3 exercises show karen, woh 2 exercises)
- Hashtags: #FitnessIndia #WorkoutAtHome #GymMotivation
social-media-marketing.answer_key: dm template, 3 influencers, collab reel idea

facebook-page-growth.title: Day 1 — Facebook Page ko Professional Setup Karna
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke apni Facebook Page ko professional banane ke liye kaunse important steps hain. Ek professional Page sehi pehchaan banta hai, credibility badhti hai aur audience trust karti hai. Iske liye profile picture, cover photo, about section, username aur privacy settings ko sahi tareeke se set karna zaroori hai.

180x180 pixels ka logo ya brand image upload karo.
2.

820x312 pixels ki attractive image jo aapke business ko represent kare.
3.

2-3 lines mein apne page ka purpose clear likho (e.g., "Hum quality products provide karte hain").
4.

@YourPageName (e.g., @TechGuruPK) set karo jo easy yaad rahe.
5.
Admin, Editor ya Moderator ko add karo agar team hai.
Apni ek existing Facebook Page ya new page bana kar upar diye gaye 5 steps ko follow karo. Har step ko screenshot lo.
Ek 100-word ka "About" section likho jo professional ho aur apne niche ke audience ko attract kare. Iske baad usko apni Facebook Page ke "About" section mein save karo.
facebook-page-growth.answer_key: logo, cover photo, about section, username, page roles

facebook-page-growth.title: Day 2 — Facebook Par Chalne Wala Content: Kya Post Karna Hai?
sections: Facebook par engagement aur reach badhane ke liye content strategy sabse zaroori hai. Basics mein aapko yeh samajhna hoga ke kaun sa content Facebook par viral hota hai—jaise emotional posts, trending topics, ya educational content. Har post ka purpose hona chahiye: ya toh audience ko entertain karna, ya inform karna, ya phir unse interact karna.

Ek fitness page ke liye "Morning Walk Benefits" naam ka post kar sakte hain. Ismein aap 3 bullet points likhein:
1. "Tension kam hota hai" (emotional hook)
2. "Heart health improve hoti hai" (educational)
3. "Free hai, kisi equipment ki zaroorat nahi" (practical benefit)
Iske saath ek motivational image ya short video clip bhi add kar sakte hain.

Apne page ke niche (jaise cooking, tech, fitness) ka ek draft post likhein. Use 3-4 lines ka banao, aur ek emotional ya educational hook zaroor add karna. (Hint: "Aapko pata hai ke..." ya "Yeh galti sab karte hain...")
Apne draft post ko 3-5 friends ko share karke unse feedback lo. Poochhein ke unko kya engaging laga aur kya improve kar sakte hain.
facebook-page-growth.answer_key: emotional hook, educational value, practical benefit

forex-trading.title: Day 1 — Forex Market Kya Hai? Aur Kaise Kaam Karta Hai?
sections: Forex (Foreign Exchange) market duniya ka sabse bara financial market hai jahan currencies ka exchange hota hai. Yeh 24/5 chalta hai (Monday se Friday, 24 ghante), kyunki har country ke markets alag-alag time zones mein khulte hain. Is market ka main purpose international trade aur investments ko facilitate karna hai. Yahan traders profit kamane ke liye currencies ki price movements par bet lagate hain.

Imagine aap India se USA travel karne ja rahe hain. Aapko $1000 chahiye. Forex market mein aap INR se USD exchange karenge. Agar 1 USD = 83 INR hai, toh aapko 83,000 INR dena hoga. Agar aapne 10,000 INR se USD liya aur next day 1 USD = 84 INR ho gaya, toh aapka profit 10,000 INR ka ho gaya (1000 USD * 1 INR ka change).

Apne mobile ya laptop se "USD to INR exchange rate" search karein. Dekhein aaj ka rate kya hai. Ab imagine kijiye aap 1000 USD khareed rahe hain. 1 week baad agar rate badh kar 85 INR ho jata hai, toh aapko kitna profit hoga?
Ek simple chart banaen jismein aap 3 currencies (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP) ke rates ko 5 dinon ke liye track karen. Har din ka rate note karen aur dekhein ki kya koi trend nazar aata hai.

forex-trading.title: Day 2
forex-trading.preamble: **Day 2 — Currency Pairs, Pips aur Lot Size: Trading Ki Duniya Ki "Mili-Metri"**
sections: Forex trading mein har trade ek *currency pair* (do currencies ka combination) par hoti hai, jaise EUR/USD ya USD/JPY. *Pip* (Percentage in Point) ek currency pair ki smallest price movement hoti hai—jaise EUR/USD mein 0.0001 ka change. *Lot size* batata hai kitni units trade ho rahi hain (Standard Lot = 100,000 units, Mini Lot = 10,000, Micro Lot = 1,000). In teen cheezon ko samajhna zaroori hai taake aapka profit/loss calculate ho sake.

Agar aap **EUR/USD** par trade kar rahe hain aur price 1.1000 se 1.1005 tak jaati hai, to aapka *pip gain* hai (1.1005 – 1.1000 = 0.0005 = **5 pips**). Agar aap **1 Mini Lot (10,000 units)** trade kar rahe hain, to har pip ka value **$1** hota hai (10,000 × 0.0001). Isliye 5 pips × $1 = **$5 profit**.

Apne MetaTrader par **GBP/JPY** pair select karein. Chart par dekhein ki current price kya hai, aur agar aap **1 Micro Lot (1,000 units)** buy karte hain, to har pip ka value kitna hoga? (Hint: GBP/JPY mein pip = 0.01, lekin value calculate karne ke liye currency ke hisaab se sochna hoga.)

Ek Excel sheet banayein jismein aap **3 different currency pairs** (jaise EUR/USD, USD/JPY, GBP/USD) ke liye **1 Standard Lot, 1 Mini Lot, aur 1 Micro Lot** ka har pip ka value calculate karein. (Example: EUR/USD ka 1 pip = $10 (Standard Lot), $1 (Mini Lot), $0.10 (Micro Lot)).

amazon-fba.title: Day 1 — Amazon FBA Kya Hai? Basics Se Shuru
sections: Amazon FBA (Fulfillment by Amazon) ek business model hai jahan aap apna product Amazon ke warehouses mein store karte hain, aur Amazon usko pack, ship, aur customer service bhi handle karta hai. Aapko sirf product research, sourcing, aur marketing par focus karna hota hai. Iske liye aapko Amazon ko fees dete hain, lekin aapko global reach, trusted brand, aur Prime customers milte hain.

Maana aap "Wireless Charging Pad" bechna chahte hain. Aap isko Alibaba se khareedte hain, Amazon ke warehouse mein bhejte hain, aur listing banate hain. Jab koi customer order karta hai, Amazon usko pack karke deliver karta hai, aur aapko payment Amazon se milta hai (minus fees).
Apne mobile ya laptop se Amazon App ya Website par jayein, aur "Amazon FBA" search karen. Dekhein ki FBA sellers ke products ka kya structure hota hai (title, images, price, etc.).
Apne mind mein ek product choose karen jo aap FBA par bech sakte hain. Uske liye 3 reasons likhein kyun yeh product Amazon par bechne layak hai (demand, competition, ya margin ke hisaab se).

amazon-fba.title: Day 2
amazon-fba.preamble: **Day 2 — Product Research: Demand, Competition aur Margin Kaise Check Karein**
sections:
Product research Amazon FBA ka sabse important step hai. Ismein hum 3 cheezon par focus karte hain:
1.

Kya log yeh product khareed rahe hain? (Search volume, BSR, trends)
2.

Kitne sellers hain? Kitne reviews hain? (Low-competition niches dhundhein)
3.
Profit kitna bachega? (Cost vs. Selling Price vs. Amazon fees)

Maana aap "Wireless Charging Pad" bechna chahte hain. Aapko pata karna hai:
-

Amazon par "Wireless Charging Pad" search karne par 50,000+ monthly searches hain (Helium 10 ya Jungle Scout se check karein).
-

Top 10 listings mein 1,000+ reviews hain → High competition. Lekin niche product "Wireless Charging Pad for Car" mein 500+ searches aur 200+ reviews hain → Better opportunity.
-
Agar supplier se Rs. 1,000 mein milta hai, aur aap Rs. 2,500 mein bechte hain, toh Amazon fees (15%) + shipping = Rs. 2,000 cost → Rs. 500 profit per unit.

Apne laptop ya phone se **Helium 10** (free trial) ya **Jungle Scout** (Chrome extension) install karein. Koi ek product category chunein (e.g., kitchen accessories) aur 3-5 products ka **demand, competition, aur estimated margin** check karein.

Ek **Google Sheet** banayein jismein aap 5 products ke liye:
- Product Name
- Monthly Searches (Demand)
- Top 3 Sellers’ Reviews (Competition)
- Estimated Profit (Margin)
- Final Verdict (Buy/Don’t Buy)
Fill karein.

amazon-fba.title: Day 3 — **Alibaba Par Trusted Suppliers Kaise Dhunde (Step-by-Step Guide)**
sections: Alibaba Amazon FBA ka backbone hai—yahan se hi aapka product source hota hai. Lekin **scam suppliers** se bachna zaroori hai. Aaj hum **verified suppliers** dhundne ke 3 asaan steps seekhenge: **Gold Supplier** filter, **Trade Assurance** check, aur **Factory Audit** kaise kare.

1. Alibaba.com par jaye → Search bar mein product likh (e.g., "Wireless Charger").
2. **Filters** lagaye: "Gold Supplier" (verified business), "Trade Assurance" (payment protection).
3. Supplier ki profile check kare: **Years in business**, **Response time**, aur **Product certifications** (e.g., CE, FCC).
Apne **Day 2 ke product** (e.g., "Portable Bluetooth Speaker") ke liye Alibaba par **3 suppliers** dhundo. Har ek ke baare mein **Gold Supplier status** aur **Trade Assurance** confirm karo.
Ek **Excel sheet** banaye jismein 3 suppliers ke naam, Gold Supplier status, aur Trade Assurance availability likhna hai.
amazon-fba.answer_key: gold supplier, trade assurance, response time, factory audit

daraz-seller.title: Day 1 — Daraz Seller Center Account Banana
sections: Daraz Seller Center he Daraz par apna online store banane ka pehla qadam hai. Yahan par aap apne products list kar sakte hain, orders manage kar sakte hain, aur apne business ko grow kar sakte hain. Pehle aapko ek verified seller account banana hota hai, jismein aapki business details, bank account, aur tax information (agar lagti hai) share karni hoti hai.

1. Daraz Seller Center ki website ya mobile app kholiye.
2. "Register as Seller" par click karein.
3. Apna email ya phone number enter karein, aur verification code enter karke verify karein.
4. Apni business type (individual ya company) select karein, aur apna CNIC ya NTN number (agar company hai) upload karein.
5. Bank details (account number, IBAN) aur tax information (agar applicable hai) fill karein.
6. Final submission ke baad, Daraz ki team aapki details verify karegi (1-3 din lag sakte hain).
Apna Daraz Seller Center account banane ka process start karein. Apni sari required documents (CNIC, bank details, etc.) ready rakhein.
Ek simple document taiyar karein jismein aapke business ki details (business name, address, contact number) aur bank details likh dein. Isse next step mein help milegi.
daraz-seller.answer_key: email/phone, verification, business type, cnic/ntn, bank details

daraz-seller.title: Day 2 — Pakistan Market Mein Best Selling Products Kaise Dhunde
sections: Aaj seekhoge ke Daraz par Pakistan mein konsi products zyada bikti hain. Product research ka matlab hai market ki demand, competition, aur profit margin check karna. Aise products chuno jo zyada search kiye ja rahe hon, kam competition ho, aur aapke budget mein aaye.

1. Daraz Seller Center > "Product Research" section mein jao.
2. "Trending Products" ya "Hot Searches" dekho.
3. "Fashion" category mein "Women's Kurtas" search karo — agar 10,000+ searches/month hain aur competition kam hai, to yeh product choose kar sakte ho.

Apne Daraz Seller Center account mein jao aur "Product Research" tool use karke **3 products** select karo jo aapko Pakistan market ke liye suitable lagte hain. Har product ke liye 2 reasons bhi likhna.

Ek Excel sheet banao jismein:
- Product name
- Monthly searches (Daraz se le sakte ho)
- Competition level (Low/Medium/High)
- Estimated profit margin (Price - Cost)
- Apka final decision (Yes/No)
daraz-seller.answer_key: trending products, low competition, high demand, profit margin

daraz-seller.title: Day 3 — **Effective Pricing Strategies for Daraz Sellers**
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke kaise apne products ki pricing karni hai jo customers ko attract kare aur profit bhi ho. Price set karne se pehle market research, competition analysis, aur cost calculation zaroori hai. Zyada kam ya zyada zyada price lagane se behtareen results nahi aate—balance banaana hai.

Ek seller 1000 rupees ka T-shirt bechta hai, lekin market mein same quality ka T-shirt 800 rupees mein mil raha hai. Agar uska cost 600 hai, toh woh 750-850 ke beech price set kar sakta hai. Agar quality better hai, toh 900-950 bhi ho sakta hai. Discounts (e.g., 10% off) lagane se bhi sales increase hoti hain.

Apne 3 best-selling products ke liye ek pricing plan banao. Har product ke liye:
1. Cost price (CP) note karo.
2. Competitors ki prices check karo (Daraz par same product search kar ke).
3. Apni ideal price range decide karo (CP + 30-50% profit).

Ek "Price Comparison Sheet" banao (Excel/Google Sheets mein). 3 columns hon:
- Product Name
- Competitor Price (lowest/highest)
- Apni Proposed Price
Is sheet ko future reference ke liye save kar ke rakhna.
daraz-seller.answer_key: cost price, competitor analysis, profit margin, discount strategy

ai-content-writing.title: Day 1 — Copywriting Basics: Hook, Benefit & CTA
sections:
Copywriting ka matlab hai words ko istemal karke readers ko action lene par majboor karna. Aaj hum 3 core elements seekhenge:
1. **Hook** – Pehla sentence jo padhne wale ko roke rakhe.
2. **Benefit** – Reader ko yeh batao ke tum usko kya dene jaa rahe ho.
3. **CTA (Call-to-Action)** – Reader ko kya karna hai, clear instruction do.

Imagine you’re selling a *"10-Minute Morning Routine"* ebook.
❌
"Wake up tired? This 10-minute routine will give you energy for the whole day—without coffee!"
"Learn 5 science-backed habits to boost focus and lose weight effortlessly."
Apne favorite product/service ka ad copy likho. Pehle 1 sentence ka **hook**, phir 1 line ka **benefit**, aur last mein **CTA** likhna hai.

Ek WhatsApp status ya Instagram caption likho jo:
- Hook: "Tired of wasting hours on social media?"
- Benefit: "This free tool blocks distractions and saves 2 hours daily."
- CTA: "DM me ‘FOCUS’ to get it now!"

ai-content-writing.title: Day 2 — AI Se Blog Articles: Draft Se Publish Tak
sections: Aaj seekhoge ke AI se blog article kaise draft karein, usko human-like banayein, aur publish ke liye edit karein. AI se content generate karna aasan hai, lekin usko authentic, engaging aur SEO-friendly banana zaroori hai. Aaj hum AI-generated draft ko refine karne ke practical steps dekhenge.

"Write a 500-word blog post in simple Urdu/Hindi about 'How to Start a Blog in 2024' for beginners. Include 3 subheadings, a hook, and a CTA."
2.

AI dega ek basic draft. Ab usko edit karna hai:
   -

Urdu/Hindi ka mix remove karke ek consistent style choose karo (e.g., pure Urdu).
   -

Friendly aur motivational rakho (e.g., "Aap bhi blogging shuru kar sakte hain!").
   -

Keywords add karo (e.g., "blogging kaise shuru karein," "free blogging platforms").
   -
Paragraphs ko short karo, bullet points add karo.
AI se ek 300-word draft generate karo "5 Gharelu Nuskay Hair Loss Rokein" topic par. Us draft ko edit karke pure Urdu mein convert karo, 2 keywords add karo, aur ek engaging CTA likho.

Ek 500-word blog post draft karo (AI se generate karke ya khud likh kar), phir usko AI tools (jaise Grammarly, Hemingway) se check karo. Improve karke ek final version taiyar karo jo publish ke liye ready ho.
ai-content-writing.answer_key: urdu/hindi consistency, keywords, engaging cta, short paragraphs

ai-content-writing.title: Day 3 — Social Media Captions & Ad Copy: Engagement Se Conversion Tak
sections: Social captions aur ad copy do alag cheez hain lekin inka maqsad ek hi hai: audience ko attract karke unse action lena. Caption wo text hai jo post ke saath jata hai (engagement ke liye), jabke ad copy wo text hai jo direct conversion ke liye design kiya gaya hai (clicks, sales, sign-ups). In dono mein hook, benefit, aur CTA ka combination hota hai—lekin ad copy mein urgency aur social proof zyada hota hai.

Ek Instagram post ke liye caption:
*"Ghar baithe paise kamane ka sabse aasan tareeka? 💰
Humara FREE ‘Content Writing Masterclass’ aaj hi join karein aur 10,000+ students ke saath seekhein! 👇
🔗 Link in bio"*

Ad copy (Facebook/Google Ads ke liye):
*"🚀 30 Dino Mein Freelance Content Writer Ban Jaeyein!
✅ 10+ Real Clients Se Kaam
✅ Har Mahine ₹50,000+ Kamayein
✅ 24/7 Support
👉 Abhi Apply Karen—Seats Limited Hain!"*
Apne favourite brand ka ek Instagram post ya ad copy likhein. Use 3-4 lines mein likhein, jismein hook (attention grabber), benefit (kyun follow/click karein), aur CTA (action) ho.

Ek 3-post series banayein (ek caption + ad copy) ek hypothetical product ke liye (jaise ek online course, fitness supplement, ya local service). Har post ka alag angle ho—ek educational, ek emotional, aur ek discount-focused.
ai-content-writing.answer_key:
caption: hook, benefit, cta
ad copy: urgency, social proof, cta

ai-tools.title: Day 1 — AI Prompts Likhna: Basics Seekhiye
sections: AI se behtareen jawab hasil karne ke liye "prompt engineering" aaj ka sabse zaroori skill hai. Ek achha prompt clear, specific aur structured hona chahiye. Basics mein hum seekhenge ki kaise simple prompts ko improve karke AI se accurate aur useful jawab len.
"Ek professional email draft karo jo ek freelancer ne apne client ko payment reminder ke liye likha hai. Email short, polite aur 3 lines se zyada na ho."
Apne mobile phone ya laptop ke liye ek **3-line ka prompt** likhiye jo AI se ek "birthday wish message" generate karne ke liye ho. (Hint: Recipient ka naam, occasion, aur tone specify karna hai.)

Ek **ChatGPT prompt library** banao (Google Sheets ya Notion mein) jismein 5 common tasks ke liye prompts hon, jaise:
- Blog post introduction
- Social media caption
- Excel formula generator
- Product description
- Meeting agenda
ai-tools.answer_key: recipient ka naam, occasion, tone, length

ai-tools.title: Day 2 — AI Se Content, Captions, Aur Emails Likhwana
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke AI tools (jaise ChatGPT, Gemini, Jasper) ko istemal karke professional aur engaging content, social media captions, aur business emails kaise likhe. AI se drafts generate karne ke baad unhe customize karna bhi seekhenge taake wo natural aur brand voice ke hisab se ho.

- Prompt: *"Write a 300-word blog post about 'How to Start Freelancing in 2024' for beginners in Hindi/Urdu."*
   - AI output ko edit karke: Add local examples (e.g., "Indian freelancers ke liye Fiverr/Upwork par kaise start kare"), simple language mein convert karna.

2.

- Prompt: *"Generate 5 Instagram captions for a post about 'AI tools for small businesses' in Hindi/Urdu, with emojis and hashtags."*
   - Example output: *"AI se apna business badhaana hai? 🚀 Yeh 5 AI tools free mein try karein! 🔥 #AI #BusinessGrowth"*

3.

- Prompt: *"Write a professional email to a client proposing a content writing service in Hindi/Urdu, with a polite tone."*
   - AI output ko customize karke: Client ka naam add karna, service details ko specific karna.

Apne liye ek prompt likho aur AI se ek **50-70 words ka Instagram caption** generate karo for a post about "AI se time save karna". Us caption ko apne brand voice (ya personal style) ke hisab se edit karo.

Ek **3-email sequence** create karo for a hypothetical client (e.g., a small business owner) using AI:
1. Introduction email (AI se draft karo)
2. Follow-up email after 3 days (AI se draft karo)
3. Final email with a CTA (Call-to-Action) like "Book a free consultation"

dropshipping.title: Day 1 — Dropshipping Model Samajhna
sections: Dropshipping ek business model hai jahan aap ek online store chalate hain lekin actual product stock nahi rakhte. Jab koi customer order deta hai, to aap uska order supplier (jaise AliExpress) ko forward kar dete hain, jo directly customer tak product bhej deta hai. Aapka profit margin product ki cost aur aapki selling price ka difference hota hai. Is model mein aapko inventory, packaging, ya shipping ka tension nahi hota.

Imagine aap ek Facebook page par "Wireless Earbuds" bech rahe hain. Koi customer Rs. 5,000 mein order deta hai. Aap uska order AliExpress supplier ko Rs. 2,500 mein forward karte hain, jo Rs. 3,000 mein product customer tak bhej deta hai. Aapka profit Rs. 2,000 rehta hai (Rs. 5,000 - Rs. 3,000).
Apne mind mein ek product choose karo jo aap bechna chahte ho (e.g., fitness band, LED lights). Socho ki us product ki cost supplier se kitni hogi aur aap usko kitne mein bech sakte ho.
Ek simple Excel sheet banao jisme 3 columns hon: Product Name, Supplier Price, Your Selling Price. Koi 5 products fill karo jo aap bech sakte ho.
dropshipping.answer_key: product name, supplier price, your selling price

dropshipping.title: Day 2 — Winning Product Ki Pehchaan: 5 Key Metrics Se Filter Karna
sections:
Winning product dhoondna dropshipping ka sabse important step hai. Aise product chunne hain jo:
1) **High demand** ho (trending ya problem solve karne wala),
2) **Low competition** ho (niche mein unique value ho),
3) **High perceived value** ho (logo ko lagta ho yeh zaroori hai),
4) **Easy to ship** ho (lightweight, no fragile items),
5) **Emotional trigger** ho (happy, angry, curious ya "must-have" feeling).

"Pet lovers" → "Automatic pet feeder" (demand high, competition medium).
-

Apne niche ke 3-5 trending products ko AliExpress par search karo. Har product ke liye yeh check karo:
✅ Price range (₨500–₨3000 ideal hai)
✅ Orders count (1000+ orders = demand proof)
✅ Reviews (4+ stars, 50+ reviews = trust)
✅ Shipping time (AliExpress Standard ya ePacket)

Ek simple spreadsheet banao:
| Product Name | Niche | Price | Orders | Avg Rating | Shipping Time | Notes |
|--------------|-------|-------|--------|------------|---------------|-------|
| Automatic Pet Feeder | Pet Lovers | $29.99 | 5,000 | 4.8 | 15-20 days | Trending, high demand |
dropshipping.answer_key: trending niche, emotional trigger, 1000+ orders, 4+ stars

dropshipping.title: Day 3 — **Local vs AliExpress Suppliers: Kaunsa Choose Karein?**
sections: Dropshipping mein supplier hi aapka business ka backbone hai. AliExpress global suppliers deta hai lekin shipping time zyada hai (15-45 days), jabki local suppliers (Pakistan se) 3-7 days mein delivery kar sakte hain lekin prices thode zyada hoti hain. Har ek ka apna faida-nuksan hai—samajh kar choose karna zaroori hai.

Agar aap *wireless earbuds* bech rahe hain:
-

Supplier China se ₹800 mein lekar ₹1500 mein bech sakte hain, lekin customer ko 20-30 days wait karna hoga.
-
Karachi se ₹1200 mein lekar ₹2000 mein bech sakte hain, delivery 3-5 days mein ho jayegi.

Apne 1-2 winning products ke liye **AliExpress** aur **local suppliers** (Facebook Groups, WhatsApp, OLX) par search karke prices, shipping time, aur reviews compare karo. Ek Excel sheet bana kar note kar lo.

Ek **supplier comparison table** banao jismein:
- Product name
- AliExpress vs Local price
- Shipping time
- Return policy
- Customer reviews (rating)
dropshipping.answer_key: aliexpress: cheap, slow, global; local: fast, expensive, local trust

freelancing.title: Day 1 — Apni Skills Kaise Choose Karein Jo Freelancing Mein Kamayein Badhayein
sections: Freelancing mein pehla aur sabse important step hai apni skills choose karna. Aapko woh skills select karni hain jo aapko pasand hain, market demand mein hain, aur aap unpar confidently kaam kar sakte hain. Zyada tar beginners yeh galti karte hain ke woh koi bhi skill choose kar lete hain bina research kiye. Aapko apni skills ka selection aise karna hai jo aapko long-term mein success dilaye.

1. Apni hobbies ya interests list karein (e.g., writing, graphic design, programming).
2. Check karein ke yeh skills ke liye market demand hai ya nahi (Upwork/Fiverr par job posts dekhein).
3. Skills ka combination banayein jo aapko unique banaye (e.g., "Graphic Design + Social Media Marketing").
Apni 3 skills select karein jo aap freelancing ke liye choose kar sakte hain. Har skill ke liye 1 reason likhein ke kyun aap usko choose kar rahe hain.

Ek simple Google Sheet banayein jismein aap 5 skills list karein jo aapko pasand hain, unke liye market demand (Upwork/Fiverr par job posts ka count), aur aapki proficiency level (Beginner/Intermediate/Expert).
freelancing.answer_key: skills list, market demand, proficiency, google sheet

freelancing.title: Day 2 — **Winning Gig/Proposal Likhne Ki 5 Step-by-Step Guide**
sections: Ek achha gig ya proposal client ko impress karne ka pehla kadam hai. Ismein **clear value proposition**, **specific benefits**, aur **call-to-action** hona zaroori hai. Copywriting ki basic techniques (like AIDA: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) use karo taake client ka focus tum par rahe.

Imagine a client searching for "logo design". Ek **bad** proposal:
*"I can design your logo. Contact me."*

Ek **achha** proposal:
*"I’ll design a **modern, scalable logo** in 48 hours that matches your brand’s personality. My past clients saw **30% more engagement** after rebranding. Let’s discuss your vision—reply with your color preferences!"*

Apne **Day 1** ke skill ke liye ek **3-line proposal** likho jo:
1. Client ki **specific problem** mention kare
2. Tumhari **unique solution** bataye
3. **Next step** (e.g., "DM me your deadline")

Ek **fake gig** create karo (Upwork/Fiverr par) for a service you can offer. Include:
- **Title** (e.g., "I’ll Design a Professional LinkedIn Banner in 24 Hours")
- **3 bullet points** of benefits
- **Pricing** (fixed or starting at $X)
freelancing.answer_key: problem solve, unique solution, clear cta, pricing transparency

freelancing.title: Day 3 — **Client Communication: First Message Se Hi Impress Kaise Karein**
sections: Freelancing mein pehla impression aapki communication se hi banta hai. Client ko yeh feel hona chahiye ke aap professional, responsive aur solution-oriented hain. Pehla message sirf "Hi" ya "I can do this" se kaam nahi chalta—usmein specificity, confidence aur call-to-action hona zaroori hai.

Ek client ne Fiverr par "Logo design" ka project post kiya hai. Aapki response yeh na ho:
❌ *"Hi, I can make logo for you. Pls msg me."*

Balke yeh ho:
✅ *"Hi [Client Name],
I noticed your project for a modern logo for your [business type]. I’ve designed 50+ logos in this niche, including for [similar client/project]. Here’s my approach:
1. We’ll discuss your brand colors & style in a quick call
2. I’ll send 3 concepts within 24 hours
3. Unlimited revisions till you’re 100% satisfied
Can we schedule a 10-min call today at 3 PM? Looking forward to your reply.
Best,
[Your Name]"*

Apne Fiverr/Upwork inbox se kisi bhi 1 pending proposal ya message ka draft likhein jo aapne abhi tak send kiya hai. Use edit karke pehle paragraph ko 3x zyada effective banayein (specificity + call-to-action add karke).
Ek dummy client ka message banaayein (jaise "I need a WordPress website for my restaurant") aur uske liye 3 different first-message drafts likhein—ek for Fiverr, ek for Upwork, aur ek for cold email.

graphic-design-canva.title: Day 1 — Canva Ka Pehla Parichay: Interface aur Basic Controls
sections: Aaj hum Canva ke dashboard aur uski basic settings se familiar honge. Canva ek drag-and-drop design tool hai jo beginners ke liye bhi bohat aasan hai. Yahan templates, elements (shapes, icons, etc.), text options, aur upload features milte hain. Pehle hum iske interface ko samajhein gaye takay agle lessons mein confidently kaam kar saken.

Canva.com par jayein, Google ya email se account banayein.

Left side mein "Create a design" button par click karen. Yahan se custom size (jaise 1080x1080px for Instagram) ya pre-set templates (jaise "Instagram Post") select karen.

Undo/Redo, save, share, aur export options.

Templates, elements (icons, shapes), text, uploads, aur background options.

Apna design yahan banayein—drag karke elements add karen.

Har selected element ki properties (color, size, effects) edit karen.
Ek naya design create karen (jaise "Facebook Post" template). Left panel se ek "Text" box add karen, usme apna naam type karen, aur right panel se font style aur color change karen.

Ek simple Instagram Post (1080x1080px) banayein jisme:

graphic-design-canva.title: Day 2 — Smart Typography: Fonts aur Unka Magic
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke kaise sahi fonts ka combination use karke design ko professional aur engaging banaya ja sakta hai. Har font ki apni personality hoti hai—kuch formal, kuch playful, kuch bold. Inhe samajh kar aur sahi tarike se pair karke apne designs ko next level par le ja sakte hain.

Ek Instagram post ke liye fonts choose karte waqt:
1. **Heading ke liye** — Bold aur modern font jaise *Poppins Bold* (formal aur clean look ke liye).
2. **Subheading ke liye** — Light aur friendly font jaise *Quicksand* (easy to read aur friendly vibe).
3. **Body text ke liye** — Simple aur readable font jaise *Open Sans* (sabse zyada user-friendly).

Canva mein ek naya design kholo (jaise Instagram post ya poster). 3 alag-alag fonts choose karke dekho ke kaun sa combination best lagta hai. Har font ka use ek alag purpose ke liye karo (heading, subheading, body).

Ek heading (bold font) + ek subheading (light font) + ek body text (simple font).
2.

Same content lekin alag fonts use karke (jaise heading ke liye *Montserrat*, subheading ke liye *Pacifico*).

Apne favorite combination ko explain karte hue ek short note add karein (kyun yeh combination best hai).

no-code-app-dev.title: Day 1 — No-Code Kya Hai? Aur Kyun Demand Mein Hai
sections: No-code ka matlab hai programming ke bina software, websites, ya apps banana. Aajkal companies aur freelancers isko isliye use kar rahe hain kyunki yeh time aur cost bachaata hai. Coding seekhne ki zaroorat nahi, drag-and-drop se kaam ho jata hai. Startups bhi isko apne MVP (Minimum Viable Product) banane ke liye use kar rahe hain.

Imagine aapko ek simple website banana hai. Normally coding seekhne mein mahine lag jate, lekin no-code tools jaise Wix ya Framer se sirf kuch ghante mein ready ho jati hai. Bas drag karke elements place karo, content add karo, aur publish kar do!
Apne phone ya laptop par Wix ya Framer ki website kholo aur ek basic "Hello World" page banane ki koshish karo. Sirf 3-4 elements (jaise heading, paragraph, button) use karo.
Ek 1-pager portfolio website banayein jisme aapka naam, ek photo, aur ek "Contact Me" button ho. (Use Framer ya Wix ka free plan.)

no-code-app-dev.title: Day 2 — Website Builders: Framer, Webflow aur Wix se Professional Website Banana
sections: Website builders jaise Framer, Webflow aur Wix no-code tools hain jo drag-and-drop interface ke zariye professional websites banane mein madad karte hain. Inme templates, animations aur hosting built-in hote hain, isliye coding ki zarurat nahi hoti. Ye platforms beginners se lekar intermediate users ke liye perfect hain.

Simple drag-and-drop se ek portfolio website banane ke liye:
   - Wix.com par jao aur "Create a Site" select karo.
   - Template choose karo (e.g., "Portfolio & CV").
   - Left panel se elements drag karke add karo (text, images, buttons).
   - "Publish" par click karo aur apni website ka link share karo.

2.

Advanced designs ke liye:
   - Webflow.com par signup karo.
   - "New Project" > "Blank" select karo.
   - Left panel se elements drag karke ek responsive navbar banayo.
   - Right panel se styles adjust karo (fonts, colors).
   - "Publish" par click karo.
Apne liye ek simple 3-page website banane ka try karo (Home, About, Contact). Kisi bhi platform (Wix/Webflow/Framer) ka use kar sakte ho. Minimum 5 elements (text, image, button) add karo.

Ek "Restaurant Menu" website banayo:
- Homepage par menu items ki list ho.
- About page par restaurant ki story ho.
- Contact page par location aur contact form ho.
- Sab pages ko navbar se link karo.
- Website ko mobile-friendly banao.
no-code-app-dev.answer_key: homepage, about page, contact page, navbar, mobile-responsive

digital-marketing-seo.title: Day 1 — Digital Marketing Ka Poora Landscape: Kya Hai Aur Kaise Shuru Karen?
sections: Digital marketing sabhi online tareeqon se apne product ya service ko promote karne ka naam hai. Ismein SEO, social media, email, ads, aur content marketing sab aate hain. Pehle samajhna zaroori hai ke yeh ek puzzle hai—har piece alag hai lekin mil kar ek picture banati hai.

Imagine a local bakery. Unke liye digital marketing ka matlab hai:
1. Google par "best cake in [city]" search karne walon ko unki website show karna (SEO)
2. Instagram par daily cake photos share karna (Social Media)
3. Customers ko birthday discounts ke liye email bhejna (Email Marketing)
4. Facebook par Rs. 500 ka ad chalana (Paid Ads)

Apne business ya interest ke hisaab se 3 digital marketing channels choose karen jinse aap apne audience tak pohanch sakte hain. (E.g., agar aap freelance writer hain to LinkedIn + Blog + Cold Email.)
Ek simple mind map banaen jismein aap apne ideal customer (e.g., "25-35 age ki working women jo healthy snacks khareedti hain") ke liye 3 best digital marketing channels select karen.

digital-marketing-seo.title: Day 2
digital-marketing-seo.preamble: **Day 2 — SEO Basics: Keywords Aur On-Page SEO Ko Samajhein**
sections: SEO ka sabse pehle step hai **keywords** samajhna aur unhe apni website par **on-page SEO** ke zariye apply karna. Keywords woh words hain jo log Google par search karte hain. On-page SEO ka matlab hai apni website ke andar hi SEO karna—jaise titles, meta descriptions, headings, aur content ko optimize karna taake search engines samajh saken ke aapka content relevant hai.

Maana ke aap ek **bakery** chalate hain. Log "best chocolate cake in Lahore" search karte hain. Aapko apne website ke:
- **Title Tag** mein: "Best Chocolate Cake in Lahore | [Bakery Name]"
- **Meta Description** mein: "Order fresh chocolate cake in Lahore with free delivery. Try our famous recipes!"
- **Content** mein: "Our chocolate cake is made with..." (yeh phrase repeat karna avoid karen, warna "keyword stuffing" ho jayega).

Apne ya kisi doosre business ka **1 keyword** choose karen (jaise "organic face cream in Karachi"). Us keyword ko apne **website ke title, meta description, aur first 100 words** mein use karen. (Agar website nahi hai, toh ek simple blog post likh kar practice karen.)

Ek **dummy webpage** banayein (Google Docs ya Notion mein) jisme:
1. Title: Apna chosen keyword shamil ho.
2. Meta description: 150-160 characters mein keyword use karke.
3. First paragraph: Keyword naturally 2-3 baar use karen (overdo na karen).
digital-marketing-seo.answer_key: keyword placement, title tag, meta description, natural density

digital-marketing-seo.title: Day 3 — Google Search Console aur Analytics: Apne Website ke Performance ko Samajhein
sections: Google Search Console (GSC) aur Google Analytics (GA4) aapki website ke health aur performance ko track karne ke liye essential tools hain. GSC aapko indexing, crawl errors, aur search rankings dikhata hai, jabki GA4 visitors, traffic sources, aur user behavior analyze karta hai. In dono ko samajh kar aap apni SEO strategy ko improve kar sakte hain.

Kisi bhi page ka URL enter karke check karen ki Google usko crawl kar raha hai ya nahi.
2.
"Acquisition" > "All Traffic" > "Source/Medium" dekh kar pata karen ke visitors aapki site par kahan se aa rahe hain (Google Search, Social Media, etc.).

1. Apni website (ya kisi dummy site) ka GSC account mein add karen.
2. "Coverage" report check karen aur koi crawl errors fix karne ki koshish karen.
3. GA4 mein ek basic report banaen (e.g., "Users by Country").
Ek 1-page report taiyar karen jismein aap GSC se top 3 search queries aur GA4 se top 3 traffic sources mention karen. (Format: "Query/Source - Clicks/Users")
digital-marketing-seo.answer_key: crawl errors, search queries, traffic sources, user behavior

video-editing.title: Day 1 — "CapCut/Premiere Ka Interface Samajhiye"
sections: Aaj hum video editing software (CapCut ya Premiere Pro) ka interface samajhenge. Har tool ki location, menus, timeline, preview panel — sabko pehchaan karna seekhenge. Yeh foundation hai editing ka, iske bina aage kuch nahi ho sakta.

Open karo → Top par "Media" (import files), "Timeline" (cutting ka area), "Preview" (right side).
2.
Apne software mein ek naya project banayein. 3-4 photos/videos import karo. Timeline par drag karo. Preview mein dekhein.
Ek 10-second clip banayein — 2 photos ko timeline par lagayein, unke beech ek transition add karo. Export karo.

video-editing.title: Day 2 — "Pacing Ka Rahasya: Rozmarra Ke Content Ko Kaise Banayein Engaging"
sections: Pacing ka matlab hai apne video ki speed ko control karna taake audience ka attention barqarar rahe. Zyada slow ho to bore ho jayega, zyada fast ho to samajh na aaye. Har platform (Reels, Shorts, YouTube) ke liye pacing alag hoti hai. Aaj seekhenge ki kaise apne cuts aur transitions ko timing de taake video engaging rahe.

Ek 15-second Reel ke liye:
1. 0-3 sec: Ek shocking clip ya hook (e.g., "Yeh trick ne meri life badal di!")
2. 3-10 sec: Main content (step-by-step process)
3. 10-15 sec: Call-to-action (e.g., "Full tutorial link bio mein hai!")
Apne phone se 10-second ka ek clip shoot karo (ya existing footage use karo). Usme 3-4 cuts lagao taake pacing natural lage. Har cut ke beech 1-2 second ka gap rakhna.

Ek 30-second ka "Tips" video banayein jisme:
- 0-5 sec: Hook (e.g., "Aap bhi yeh galti karte hain!")
- 5-20 sec: 3 tips (har tip ke beech 2-3 sec ka gap)
- 20-30 sec: Conclusion + CTA

video-editing.title: Day 3 — **Subtitles Ki Power: Accessibility aur Engagement Badhaein**
sections: Subtitles sirf unke liye nahi hain jo sun nahi sakte—instead, yeh engagement badhane ka *secret weapon* hain. Studies ke mutabiq, 85% social media users videos mute kar ke dekhte hain, lekin subtitles add karne se *retention* 40% tak badh jati hai. Aaj hum seekhenge ke kaise accurate, stylish aur engaging subtitles banayein jo content ko professional bana dein.

CapCut mein subtitles add karne ka *fastest* tarika:
1. **Auto-Caption** (15 sec ka clip select kar ke "Text" > "Auto Caption" par click karen).
2. **Edit** kar ke timing adjust karen (drag kar ke words ko split/merge karen).
3. **Style** change karen: Font (Montserrat), Size (48-60), Color (white with black outline), Position (bottom-center).
4. **Background** add karen (optional: 50% opacity black rectangle).
Apne *Day 2* ke edited clip mein subtitles add karen. 3-5 seconds ke har shot ke liye 1 line ka caption likhein (e.g., "Yeh hai mera favorite editing trick!").

Ek 15-second ka *Reel/Short* banayein jisme:
- 3 different caption styles hon (bold, italic, colored).
- 1 transition ke saath caption appear ho.
- Background music sync ho.
video-editing.answer_key: auto-caption, timing adjust, font style, background opacity

print-on-demand.title: Day 1 — Print on Demand Kya Hai? Basics Se Shuru
sections: Print on Demand (POD) ek aisa business model hai jahan aap kisi product (T-shirt, mug, poster, etc.) ka design upload karte hain, aur jab koi customer order deta hai, tab hi wo product print hota hai aur deliver kiya jata hai. Aapko koi inventory rakhne ki zaroorat nahi hoti—sab kuch supplier handle karta hai. Yeh ek low-risk business hai kyunki aapko pehle se paise lagane ki zarurat nahi hoti.

Imagine aap ek T-shirt design banate hain "Dil Se Pakistan" aur usko Printful par upload karte hain. Koi customer wo T-shirt order karta hai, to Printful usko print karta hai, pack karta hai, aur customer tak pohancha deta hai. Aapko sirf design aur marketing ka kaam hai—baaki sab supplier ka.

Apne mobile ya laptop se yeh check karo: [Printful](https://www.printful.com/) ya [Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/) ki website par jao aur dekhho ki kaunse products par designs upload kiye ja sakte hain.

Ek simple design banao (Canva ya phone ke drawing app se) jo aapko pasand ho—jaise "Pakistan Zindabad" ya "Love Pakistan"—aur usko ek POD platform par upload karne ka screenshot le lo (agar possible ho).
print-on-demand.answer_key: design upload, inventory zero, supplier prints

print-on-demand.title: Day 2 — Print on Demand Ke Liye Best Platform Kaise Chunein?
sections: Print on Demand (POD) mein platform choose karna ek critical decision hai jo aapke business ki cost, quality, aur scalability par asar dalta hai. Aapko in factors par dhyaan dena hoga: shipping time, product quality, pricing, aur integration options (jaise Shopify, Etsy, Amazon). Local vendors vs international POD platforms (jaise Printful, Printify, Redbubble) mein se kya choose karna hai, yeh decide karna hai.

Agar aap India se hain aur local customers ko target kar rahe hain, toh **Printrove** (Indian POD service) better ho sakta hai kyunki shipping fast hoga aur cost bhi kam. Lekin agar global audience hai, toh **Printful** ya **Printify** (jo multiple warehouses ke saath work karte hain) better options hain.

Apne business model ke hisaab se 2 POD platforms ko shortlist karein aur unke:
1. Shipping time aur cost
2. Product range
3. Integration options
Compare karein. (Hint: Printful aur Printify ki websites par jaake check karein.)
Ek simple comparison chart banaein (Excel ya Canva mein) jismein aapne shortlisted 2 platforms ke upar 3-4 key factors compare karein.
print-on-demand.answer_key: printful: global warehouses, high quality, shopify integration; printify: cheaper, more product options, flexible

cpp-daily-coding.title: Day 1 — C++ Setup aur "Hello World" Program
sections: Aaj hum C++ programming shuru karne se pehle apne system par C++ compiler aur IDE (Integrated Development Environment) setup karenge. Compiler code ko machine language mein translate karta hai, jabki IDE coding, debugging aur running ko asaan banata hai. Pehle program ko "Hello World" kehte hain—yeh programming ki starting point hoti hai.

- Windows: [MinGW-w64](https://www.mingw-w64.org/) download karein (ya [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/)).
   - Mac: Terminal mein `xcode-select --install` run karein.
   - Linux: `sudo apt install g++` (Ubuntu/Debian) ya `sudo dnf install gcc-c++` (Fedora).

2.

cpp-daily-coding.title: Day 2 — Variables aur Data Types: Apne Programs Ko Smarter Banana
sections: Variables memory mein storage ke liye containers hote hain. Har variable ka ek data type hota hai (jaise int, float, char) jo batata hai ke usme kya type ka data store hoga. Input/output (cin/cout) se user se data le sakte hain aur results show kar sakte hain.
Ek program banayein jo user se **name** (string), **age** (int), aur **height** (float) input le aur phir sabko ek line mein print kare.
Ek **Simple Calculator** banayein jo do numbers input le aur un par +, -, *, / operations perform karke results show kare.

python-programming.title: Day 1 — Python Install Karna aur Pehla Program
sections: Python install karna ek beginner ke liye sabse pehla aur zaroori step hai. Hum Python ki official website se installer download karke install karenge. Phir ek simple "Hello World" program likhenge taake Python ka basic structure samajh aaye. Yehi program Python ki coding ka foundation hai.

1. [Python ki official website](https://www.python.org/downloads/) par jao.
2. "Download Python" button par click karo (latest version select karna).
3. Installer run karo, **"Add Python to PATH"** checkbox check karna mat bhulna.
4. "Install Now" par click karo aur wait karo.
5. Command Prompt (Windows) ya Terminal (Mac/Linux) kholo aur `python --version` ya `python3 --version` type karo taake confirm ho jaaye ke Python install ho gaya hai.
6. Ab ek file `hello.py` banao aur usme yeh code likho:
   ```python
   print("Hello World!")
   ```
7. Terminal mein `python hello.py` ya `python3 hello.py` likh kar Enter dabao. Output aana chahiye: `Hello World!`
Apne system par Python install karo aur ek file `first.py` banao. Usme apna naam print karne wala code likho (e.g., `print("Mera naam [Apna Naam] hai")`). Terminal se run karo.

excel-data-analysis.title: Day 1 — Excel Interface aur Pehla Formula: `SUM`
sections: Aaj hum Excel ka basic interface samajhein ge aur pehla formula `SUM` use karna seekhein ge. Excel ka ribbon (top menu), formula bar, cells, aur sheets ka basic structure dekhein ge. `SUM` formula numbers ko add karne ka sabse easy tareeka hai—bas numbers select karo ya type karo aur result milega.

1. Excel kholo, ek naya sheet banayein.
2. A1 mein `5`, B1 mein `10`, C1 mein `15` type karen.
3. D1 mein cursor rakhein, `=` type karen, phir `SUM(` likhein.
4. A1:C1 select karen (ya `A1,B1,C1` type karen), phir `)` close karen.
5. Enter press karen—D1 mein `30` aana chahiye.
Ek naya sheet banayein aur A1:A5 mein yeh numbers type karen: `20, 35, 10, 45, 50`. Phir B1 mein `SUM` formula use karke in sabka total nikalain.

Ek simple "Monthly Expense Tracker" banayein:
- A1:A7 mein yeh labels type karen: `Rent, Groceries, Transport, Bills, Entertainment, Savings, Total`
- B1:B6 mein yeh amounts type karen (apne hisaab se, e.g., `15000, 8000, 3000, 2000, 5000, 10000`)
- B7 mein `SUM(B1:B6)` formula use karke total expenses nikalain.

crypto-blockchain.title: Day 1 — Blockchain: Digital Ledger Jo Sabko Trust Karta Hai
sections: Blockchain ek digital ledger (record book) hai jo transactions ko secure, transparent aur decentralized tareeqe se record karta hai. Har "block" mein transactions ka group hota hai, aur har block ko cryptographic hash se link kiya jata hai—jaise ek digital finger print. Isse koi bhi cheat nahi kar sakta, kyunki agar koi block change karega toh saare subsequent blocks invalid ho jayenge.

Imagine a Google Sheet jo sabke phone par open hai, lekin koi bhi ek line edit nahi kar sakta bina sabke agreement ke. Agar koi line change karega, toh saare logko pata chal jayega. Yeh hi blockchain ka basic idea hai—ek shared, unchangeable record.

Apne phone ya laptop par ek simple blockchain explorer open karo (jaise [blockchain.com/explorer](https://www.blockchain.com/explorer)). Bitcoin network par koi recent transaction search karo aur dekh lo:
- Transaction ID (TXID)
- Sender aur Receiver ke addresses
- Amount (kitne Bitcoin transfer hue)

psx-stock-trading.title: Day 1 — PSX Ki Pehchaan: Pakistan Stock Exchange Kya Hai?
sections: PSX (Pakistan Stock Exchange) ek aisa market hai jahan companies apne shares bechti hain aur investors un shares ko khareed kar company ke hissaidar ban sakte hain. Yahan par shares ki khareedi-bikri hoti hai, jise trading kehte hain. PSX ek regulated platform hai jahan har din lakhon log trading karte hain aur company ke performance ke hisab se shares ke prices badalte rehte hain.

Imagine a company "XYZ Ltd" jo apne business ko grow karne ke liye investors se paise lena chahti hai. Wo PSX par apne 1 million shares 100 rupees ke price par offer karti hai. Agar aap 100 shares khareedte hain, to aap XYZ Ltd ke 0.01% ke malik ban jate hain. Agar company aage badti hai, to share ka price 150 rupees ho sakta hai, aur aapko profit hoga.

Apne mobile ya computer par "PSX" search karein aur PSX ki official website ya app open karein. Dekhein ki "Market Summary" ya "Indices" section mein PSX-100, KSE-30 jaise terms hain. Inhe samajhein ki yeh kya represent karte hain.

Ek chhota sa research karein: PSX par listed 3 companies ke names aur unke shares ke current prices (Google par "PSX [company name] share price" search kar ke) note karein. In companies ke business ke bare mein 1 line mein likhein (e.g., "Engro Corp: Fertilizer aur food products banane wali company").

tiktok-growth.title: Day 1 — TikTok Algorithm Ki Powerful Secrets
sections: TikTok ka algorithm har user ki har activity track karta hai—watch time, likes, shares, comments, even video completion rate. Ye dekh kar decide karta hai ke kya content recommend karna hai. Key factors: **Retention** (kitna time user ne video dekha), **Engagement** (kitne fast reactions aaye), aur **Trending Topics** (jo viral ho rahe hain). Algorithm fresh creators ko bhi chance deta hai agar content engaging ho.

Ek new creator ne 15-second dance video banaya. Uske 10 followers ne 100% video dekhi, 3 ne like kiya, 1 ne share kiya. Algorithm samjha ke ye engaging hai, isliye usko "For You Page" par recommend kiya. Next video par uske 500 followers ho gaye.

Apne TikTok app mein jayein → "For You" page par scroll karein → 3 videos select karein jo aapko pasand aaye. Har video ke niche "Why this?" ka reason sochain (e.g., "Isme sound viral hai" ya "User ne 90% video dekhi").

Apne phone ke gallery se 3-5 videos select karein jo aapke hisaab se engaging hon (chahay wo aapke na bhi ho). Har video ke liye note karein:
- Video length
- First 3 seconds mein kya hua
- Kya sound use hua
- Engagement rate (likes/shares/comments)

blogging-adsense.title: Day 1 — Apna Blog Ka Niche Kaise Choose Karein? (Beginner-Friendly Guide)
sections: Blog ka niche select karna sabse pehla aur sabse important step hai. Niche matlab aapka blog kis topic par hoga—jaise technology, health, finance, ya travel. Ek achha niche choose karne se aapka content focused rahega, readers engage honge, aur Adsense approval bhi asaan ho jata hai. Aapka interest, market demand, aur competition ko balance karna hoga.

Agar aapko cooking pasand hai, lekin "10-minute recipes" ka demand zyada hai, to yeh niche choose kar sakte hain.
2.
Google par "best budget smartphones 2024" search karke dekhiye kitne blogs hain. Agar 10,000+ results hain, to competition zyada hai—niche narrow karne ki zaroorat hai.

Apne 3 topics list karein jo aapko pasand hain (e.g., fitness, personal finance, parenting). Har topic ke liye 3 sub-niches banaein (e.g., "home workouts for beginners," "side hustles for students," "toddler meal plans").

Ek Google Sheets banayein jismein:
- Column 1: Main niche
- Column 2: Sub-niche
- Column 3: Google Trends par search volume (trends.google.com)
- Column 4: Competition score (1-10, 10 = zyada competition)

photography-editing.title: Day 1
photography-editing.preamble: **Day 1 — Camera/Phone Settings: Basics Se Shuru Karain**
sections: Aaj hum seekhein ge ke camera ya phone ki basic settings (ISO, aperture, shutter speed, white balance) kya hain aur yeh photos par kaise asar dalte hain. Har setting ki importance samajh kar, aap apne device ko better control kar sakte hain—chahe wo DSLR ho ya smartphone.

*Smartphone example:* Agar aap koi photo low light mein le rahe hain, toh ISO badha kar (e.g., 800-1600) photo bright ho sakti hai, lekin noise (grain) bhi aayega. Agar aap fast-moving object (e.g., running dog) capture kar rahe hain, toh shutter speed 1/500s ya zyada rakhein warna blur aayega.

Apne phone ya camera ki settings mein ja kar:
1. ISO ko 100 (daylight) se 800 (low light) tak manually badha kar dekhain.
2. Shutter speed ko 1/60s (slow) aur 1/500s (fast) par set kar ke ek hi object ki 2 photos leain.

Ek hi scene ki 3 photos leain:
- ISO 100 (bright light, no noise)
- ISO 1600 (low light, check noise)
- Shutter speed 1/30s (blur if hand moves) vs 1/500s (sharp).

voiceover-podcasting.title: Day 1 — Voice Over Ki Basics: Apna Mic Set Karein
sections: Aaj hum seekhenge ke voice over ke liye sabse pehle kya zaroori hai—ek accha mic setup. Ek behtar mic aur proper positioning se aapki awaaz professional aur clear aati hai. Basics mein microphone types (USB vs XLR), room acoustics, aur positioning jaise cheezon par focus karenge.

Agar aap beginner hain, toh USB mic (jaise Blue Yeti ya FIFINE K669B) istemal karen. XLR mic zyada advanced hain aur extra interface ki zaroorat hoti hai.
2.

Ek quiet room mein recording karen. Agar aapke paas soundproof room nahi hai, toh ek blanket ya foam panels laga kar echo kam karen.
3.
Mic ko apne munh se 6-12 inches door rakhein. "Pop filter" use karen taake "P" aur "B" jaise words se aane wale harsh sounds kam hon.

Apne mic ko connect karen aur ek 30-second ka recording karen—apni awaaz ko describe karen (jaise "Mera naam hai [X], aur main voice over artist banna chahta hoon"). Check karen ke awaaz clear hai ya nahi.
Ek 1-minute ka intro script likhein (jaise podcast ya voice over ke liye) aur usko record karen. Try karen ke tone natural ho aur mic se 6-12 inches door rahein.
voiceover-podcasting.answer_key: usb mic, room quiet, 6-12 inches, pop filter

real-estate-business.title: Day 1 — Pakistan ke Real Estate Market ki Basics
sections: Pakistan ka real estate market dynamic hai—shahar se lekar gaon tak har jagah alag trends hain. Yahan property ki demand, prices, aur legal rules city aur region ke hisaab se badalti rehti hain. Shuruat mein market ko samajhna zaroori hai taake aap informed decisions le saken.

Karachi mein Defence Housing Authority (DHA) aur Bahria Town ki properties zyada demand mein hain, jabke Lahore mein Gulberg aur Johar Town popular hain. Property prices bhi in areas mein zyada hoti hain.
Apne local area mein 3 popular residential projects ya societies ka naam likhein jo abhi demand mein hain.

Ek simple market research karke ek table banaein:
| Area Name | Popular Society/Project | Avg. Price (per kanal/sq.ft) | Demand Reason |

mobile-repairing.title: Day 1 — Mobile Repairing Ke Liye Zaroori Basic Tools
sections: Mobile repairing ke liye sabse pehle aapko kuch basic tools ki pehchaan ho jani chahiye. Yeh tools aapki repair ko aasan aur professional banate hain. Har repair ke liye alag tool ki zarurat hoti hai, isliye inki pehchaan aur istemal ka tareeka aana zaroori hai.

Agar aapko kisi mobile ki screen replace karni hai, toh aapko **Pentalobe screwdriver**, **plastic pry tools**, **suction cup**, aur **heat gun** ki zarurat hogi. Pehle screws ko nikalne ke liye Pentalobe screwdriver use karo, phir plastic pry tools se screen ko gently lift karo.
Apne paas ek purana mobile le kar aao, aur uske screws ko nikal kar dekhho ke kaunsa screwdriver kaam karega (Phillips, Flathead, ya Pentalobe).
Ek chhota sa toolkit banao jismein 3-4 basic tools hon (jaise screwdriver set, tweezer, plastic pry tool). Inhe ek box mein arrange karo taake repair ke waqt aasani ho.

kids-safety-education.title: Day 1 — Mera jism sirf mera hai
sections: Bachay, tumhara jism tumhara hai—sirf tumhara! Koi bhi insaan tumse poochhe bina tumhare sharir ko chho sakta hai, tumhe gale laga sakta hai, ya tumhe kiss kar sakta hai. Agar tumhe koi cheez achchi nahi lagti, toh tumhe "na" kehne ka poora haq hai. Koi bhi tumhe "secret" rakhne ke liye majboor nahi kar sakta.

Aman ko school se aate waqt ek aadmi ne kaha, "Beta, mere gale lag jao!" Aman ne socha, "Mujhe yeh pasand nahi," aur usne "na" keh diya. Us aadmi ne kaha, "Arre, yeh toh chhota sa baap hai!" Aman ne apne teacher ko bataya, aur teacher ne us aadmi ko samjhaya.
Ammi Abbu Ke Sath Baat Karein
"Beta, agar koi tumse koi cheez pooche bina tumhare sharir ko chho le, toh tum kya karoge?"
Tumhara jism tumhara hai—kisi ko bhi tumse poochhe bina chho na! Agar koi cheez ajeeb lage, toh foran ammi-abbu ko batana.
